title: 1990s drilling near the Sphinx overseen by Hawass

tellings.quote: And the drilling that they did in the '9s to see if there was a to see if there was a chamber there, that was overseen by Zawas.

plain: In the 1990s, drilling was done near the Sphinx in Egypt to check for a hidden chamber, and the Egyptian archaeologist Zahi Hawass oversaw it. A researcher named Luke Caverns says this to Michels without giving a source, suggesting the search for chambers there was controlled by one man.
